en: The Apadāna of the Elder Vedikāraka Udakāsanavagga 5 I was a builder of railings for the Tathāgata, And I offered a seat made of water. By that merit, I have been reborn in heaven, And now I am a sage, free from defilements. Having lived the holy life under the Buddha Kassapa, I have attained final Nibbāna, reaching the end of suffering.
With a clear mind and joyful heart, [I stood] before the supreme Bodhi tree of the Blessed One Vipassī.
I do not know a state of woe;
this is the fruit of the railing.
In the eleventh aeon from now,
I was equal to the sun;
I was a mighty wheel-turning monarch.
[and so on] ...the Buddha’s teaching has been accomplished.
Thus indeed the venerable elder Vedikāraka spoke these verses.
This is the fifth legend of the elder Vedikāraka.
